source: Catalog entries for the five cars imported on 2026-10-15. They are not in data/vehicles/catalog.json yet because the catalog refuses an entry whose model file is missing and the GLBs (Git LFS) are generated locally: after `python3 tools/carimport/carimport.py`, insert these entries after car_phoenix_455 in catalog.json. Spawn heights: base car's spawn plus the larger wheel radius (+4 mm margin).

vehicles.title: Ace 11
vehicles.subtitle: Three-door city car
vehicles.description: A small three-door city car on the Pico's 1.0 litre three and five-speed gearbox. Imported CC BY model by Daniel Zhabotinsky.

chassis.source: car_city chassis, spawn 16 mm higher for the 16 mm larger wheel radius; the imported art is visual only
